# Google Maps Nearby Radius Search — Address, Place & Coordinates

Point this actor at a coordinate, an address, or a Google Maps place, give it a
radius and one or more categories or keywords, and it returns the places Google
shows inside that radius. Every row carries its straight-line distance from the
center, so "within 800 m of this address" is an auditable number instead of a
relevance guess.

It reads Google Maps' public result feed without a browser, cookies or an API
key. Runs are small (1 GB), fast, and do not need proxy configuration.

## Search center

Choose one center type:

| Center type | What to provide | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Coordinates | `latitude` + `longitude` | `40.7484`, `-73.9857` |
| Address | `address` | `350 5th Ave, New York, NY 10118` |
| Place | `place` (Maps URL or ChIJ Place ID) | `https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id:ChIJ...` |

An address or place is resolved to Google's own coordinates first, then the
radius search is anchored there. A place can be a full Maps URL, a short
`maps.app.goo.gl`-style link, or a canonical `ChIJ...` Place ID.

## What it collects

For every place inside the radius:

- `name`, `categoryName`, `categories`
- `totalScore`, `reviewsCount`, `ratingHistogram`
- `address`, `phone`, `website`
- `priceLevel`, `plusCode`, `description`
- `hours`, `hoursStatus`, `isOpenNow`
- `timezone`, `countryCode`
- `placeId`, `featureId`, `kgmid`, `cid`
- `location` (`{lat,lng}`), `latitude`, `longitude`
- `distanceFromCenter` (e.g. `450 m`), `distanceFromCenterMeters`
- `photosSample`, `photoCount`
- `placeAttributes`, `attributes`, `amenities`, `serviceOptions`
- `fuelPrices`, `hotelStars`, `hotelStarRating`, `priceOfferAmount`,
  `priceOfferCurrency`, `priceOfferDateRange`, `hotelAmenities`
- `bookingLinks`, `checkInTime`, `checkOutTime`
- `hasStreetView`, `streetViewCount`
- `permanentlyClosed`, `temporarilyClosed`, `claimed`
- `searchTerm`, `rankInSearch`
- `googleMapsUrl`, `sourceUrl`, `scrapedAt`, `recordType`

Fields Google does not publish for a place are omitted, never sent as `null` or
an empty string. `includeDetails` adds the preview-panel fields (plus code,
price, histogram, photos, description, attributes, service options, closure
status and hotel/fuel/booking extras when Google publishes them) and costs one
extra request per place; listing fields and weekly hours are collected either
way.

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `centerType` | select | `coordinates` | `coordinates`, `address` or `place` |
| `latitude` | number | `40.7484` | Center latitude for coordinate mode |
| `longitude` | number | `-73.9857` | Center longitude for coordinate mode |
| `address` | string | — | Center for address mode |
| `place` | string | — | Maps URL or ChIJ Place ID for place mode |
| `searchTerms` | string list | `["coffee shop"]` | One or more categories/keywords (required) |
| `radiusKm` | number | `1` | Hard radius, 0.05–50 km |
| `maxResults` | integer | `50` | Maximum places per term |
| `includeDetails` | boolean | `true` | Read each place's preview panel |
| `minRating` / `maxRating` | number | — | Inclusive rating bounds |
| `minReviews` / `maxReviews` | integer | — | Inclusive review-count bounds |
| `openNow` | boolean | `false` | Keep only places observed open |
| `hasWebsite` / `hasPhone` | boolean | `false` | Require the field |
| `includeClosed` | boolean | `true` | Keep permanently closed places |
| `nameFilter` | string | — | Name must contain this text |
| `excludeCategories` | string list | `[]` | Drop matching categories |
| `language` | select | `en` | 74 Google Maps UI languages |

### Examples

Coffee within 500 m of Times Square:

```json
{
  "centerType": "coordinates",
  "latitude": 40.7484,
  "longitude": -73.9857,
  "searchTerms": ["coffee shop"],
  "radiusKm": 0.5,
  "maxResults": 30
}
```

Highly rated, open-now restaurants around an address:

```json
{
  "centerType": "address",
  "address": "10 Downing St, London SW1A 2AA",
  "searchTerms": ["restaurant"],
  "radiusKm": 2,
  "minRating": 4.5,
  "openNow": true,
  "maxResults": 50
}
```

Pharmacies and clinics around a place URL, in French:

```json
{
  "centerType": "place",
  "place": "https://www.google.com/maps/place/Eiffel+Tower/@48.8583701,2.2944813,17z",
  "searchTerms": ["pharmacy", "clinic"],
  "radiusKm": 3,
  "includeDetails": false,
  "language": "fr",
  "maxResults": 40
}
```

## How pagination works

Google serves the nearby feed in pages of 20 ranked places. The actor follows
those pages until the per-term `maxResults` is reached, the feed returns an
empty section, or two consecutive pages contain nothing inside the radius
(Google appends unrelated places from other cities at the end of a window).
Deduplication is by Place ID, then feature ID, then Maps URL, then name +
address.

A single term's ranked window usually holds roughly 130–180 places inside a
dense radius. When that window ends, the actor stops and says so in the status
message rather than padding the dataset. For more coverage, split the area into
smaller radii or run several narrower category terms.

## FAQ

**Do I need a Google Maps API key or cookies?** No. The actor reads the same
public result and preview endpoints the Maps website uses, with no account,
cookie or key.

**Do I need a proxy?** No. It starts direct, and only if Google repeatedly
blocks the connection does it move to Apify's datacenter pool and then US
residential as a last resort. There is no proxy field to configure.

**Why are there fewer rows than `maxResults`?** The ranked window ends, or the
radius/filters removed places. The status message reports how many rows were
outside the radius and how many were filtered. A tight radius or strict
`openNow` filter can legitimately return zero rows.

**Why is `distanceFromCenter` missing?** It is never missing on a returned row:
a place without observed coordinates is dropped because it cannot be proven
inside the radius.

**Can I search more than one category in one run?** Yes. Put several entries in
`searchTerms`; each term is searched and paginated separately, and every row
records which term found it. `maxResults` applies per term.

**Why do some detail fields appear only sometimes?** Plus code, price level,
rating histogram, description and attributes are conditional on Google
publishing them for that place. Omitted means Google did not show it.

**Does a smaller radius return more accurate results?** Yes. The radius also
selects the map zoom used for the search, so a 500 m request is anchored on a
much tighter viewport than a 20 km request.

**Is this affiliated with Google?** No. It reads publicly visible Google Maps
data and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Google.

## Limitations

- One term's ranked window is finite; the actor reports the honest source end
  instead of inventing rows.
- Popular times, menus, reviews, emails and social profiles belong to separate
  actors in this suite.
- Bounding-box, polygon and multi-cell grid scans belong to the area-scanner
  actor.
- Google localises names, addresses and hours with `language`; the values are
  returned exactly as Google serves them.
